description: This file implements a Kivy-based GUI application for browsing and editing widget demos and their associated .kv language files. It defines classes for the main app, container widgets, text input, and catalog management, including dynamic loading and reloading of .kv files, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: Container
classes.description: A container class that loads its widget hierarchy from a .kv file based on its class name, allowing dynamic reloading.

classes.name: KivyRenderTextInput
classes.description: A subclass of CodeInput that overrides key handling to trigger saving when 'Ctrl+S' or 'Cmd+S' is pressed.

classes.name: Catalog
classes.description: Main widget managing the widget demo catalog, including loading, displaying, and editing .kv files, and handling user interactions.

classes.name: KivyCatalogApp
classes.description: The Kivy application class that initializes and runs the catalog interface.

methods.name: Container.__init__
methods.description: Initializes the container by loading its associated .kv file and applying its widget rules.

methods.name: Container.kv_file
methods.description: Property that returns the path to the container's .kv file based on its class name.

methods.name: KivyRenderTextInput.keyboard_on_key_down
methods.description: Handles key events to detect 'Ctrl+S' or 'Cmd+S' for saving the current .kv code.

methods.name: Catalog.show_kv
methods.description: Displays the selected .kv file content in the editor pane.

methods.name: Catalog.schedule_reload
methods.description: Schedules reloading of the .kv code if auto-reload is enabled and changes are detected.

methods.name: Catalog.change_kv
methods.description: Parses and applies the .kv code entered by the user, updating the widget display or showing errors.

methods.name: Catalog.show_error
methods.description: Displays an error message when parsing or applying .kv code fails.

methods.name: KivyCatalogApp.build
methods.description: Builds and returns the root Catalog widget.

methods.name: KivyCatalogApp.on_pause
methods.description: Handles app pause event, returning True to indicate pause handling.
